evidenceCoverage.baselineDescription: No pre-adoption comparison is included; observations begin at adoption.
evidenceCoverage.reason: No comparable pre-adoption outcome evaluation is established for this contract.

caveat: The evidence measures post-adoption attainment only; without a comparable pre-adoption baseline it cannot establish improvement or causation.

intent.goal: For every admitted PR-context invocation, check out the intended PR head in a clean initialized Git workspace with origin and visible history.
intent.acceptance: Join the original GitHub event and source policy to a contemporaneous expected PR head/ref and protected pre-agent Git readback; require matching head/ref, clean status, origin, visible commit and a non-main branch.

antecedent.reason: PR checkout and this same Git-state conjunction predate workflow adoption; immutable source cannot reconstruct a historical runner workspace or dispatch payload.

requiredSources: protected Git state before agent execution

evidence.opportunity: Every policy-admitted initial PR-context invocation, including dispatch, centralized slash dispatch and direct PR/comment triggers; no-PR controls are separate.
filters: Not proof: checkout_pr_success (also true for skipped and closed-PR paths)
Not proof: current PR head backdated
The function is valid prospectively; measurement remains blocked without independent event/head/workspace receipts.
No successful step or exported baseline alone proves a clean initialized workspace.
Protected post-agent logs and agent reports cannot establish the required pre-agent state.
No costs, sole causation, adoption-relative improvement or keep/retire bar is measured.
evidence.collection: Offline replay of digest-checked all-run inventory, original event, immutable source policy, expected PR-head and protected pre-agent Git state; absent receipts remain null.

model.recommendation: Do not rate value until authentic checkout receipts exist; preserve partial head-match evidence independently.

metrics.name: Verified PR checkouts
metrics.formula: Count distinct initial invocation opportunities with independently established complete checkout conjunction; unknown outcomes are not zero.

metrics.name: Verified intended PR heads
metrics.formula: Count independent intended PR head/ref matches; does not assert a clean workspace.
